decision_conditions: The proposed balconies, by virtue of its siting, form and orientation and proximity to neighbouring fenestration would give rise to an unneighbourly loss of privacy and overlooking as perceived from Flat 3, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8 and DMD10 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed balconies, by virtue of their design and inadequate floor areas would result in substandard private amenity space incapable of meeting the reasonable needs of occupiers, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3, D4, D6 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8 and DMD9 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Variation of condition 02 of Ref: 22/03019/FUL to allow installation of two balconies.
